name: QuestBeats VR Music Player
summary:
QuestBeats is a standalone music player built for Meta Quest — your library, your headset, no phone required.

PLAY THE MUSIC YOU ALREADY OWN
QuestBeats finds and plays audio straight from the headset's storage, a plugged-in USB-OTG drive, or shared folders on your home network over SMB. Supported formats include MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC/M4A and OGG/Opus.
